name: FV_PAYMENT_FORMAT_MAPPINGS
description: This table contains the payment format mapping configuration

columns.name: FORMAT_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the payment format mapping.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment type mapping is applicable to either the PAM or SPS payment format.

columns.name: PAY_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Indicates pay group associated with the payment format.The value will be one of the look up codes from lookup type ORA_AP_PAY_GROUP.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment type associated with the pay group. For the PAM payment format, the value will be one of the look up codes from lookup type ORA_FV_PAM_PAYMENT_TYPE. For SPS the value will be one of the look up codes from lookup type ORA_FV_SPS_PAYMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: CHECK_FORMAT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of check format. The values for the field are based on lookup type ORA_FV_CHECK_PAYMENT_FORMATS and valid values are Check with Stub, Check without Stub.

columns.name: ELECTRONIC_FORMAT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of electronic format. For the PAM payment format the possible values are defined in the lookup type ORA_FV_PAM_ACH_PAYMENT_FORMATS and valid values are PPD, CCD, IAT, CTX. For SPS the possible values are defined in the lookup type ORA_FV_SPS_ACH_PAYMENT_FORMATS and valid values are PPD, CCD, PPD SDP, CCD SDP, IAT.

columns.name: WIRE_FORMAT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates wether the payment format is for  wire payment.
